item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0015-R01-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0015-R01-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0015-R01-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On 20 February 2023, the UN Special Procedures recorded information concerning the ongoing prosecution of Ms. Rozina Islam, identified in the entry as a journalist for Prothom Alo newspaper.","notes":["The excerpt says “an investigate journalist,” so the summary is narrowed to the supported identification without upgrading it to “investigative journalist.”"]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0015-R01-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The UN Special Procedures recorded information concerning harassment and death threats against Mr. Shahanur Islam, a lawyer, allegedly for legitimate activities in exercise of the legal profession.","notes":["The supplied excerpt does not include the proposed 17 January 2023 date; the date is therefore removed."]}]}
